meta_description: Ace Painting and Decorating in Newcastle offers interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and decorating. Free quotes, reliable local service.
hero_subhead: From fresh interior walls to complete exterior refresh, we transform your home with precision and care.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Newcastle
services_subhead: Whether you need a quick refresh or a full transformation, we handle residential and commercial projects with professionalism and attention to detail.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Room refresh or full house repaint. We prepare surfaces properly, use quality finishes, and leave your home spotless. Colour consultation included.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior paints protect and beautify your home. We handle gutters, fascias, doors, and full facade work.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Coverings
services.desc: Feature walls, full room coverage, or specialist finishes. We hang patterned, textured, and lining papers with precision.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Painting
services.desc: Skirting boards, doors, window frames, and fitted furniture painted to a hard-wearing finish that lasts years.

services.title: Commercial Decorating
services.desc: Offices, retail spaces, and business properties. We work efficiently to minimise disruption to your operation.

services.title: Prep & Problem Solving
services.desc: Damp walls, old paint, plaster damage — we diagnose and prepare surfaces properly so the finish lasts.

about_pullquote: Good preparation and honest pricing — that's how we've built our reputation.
about_para_1: Ace Painting and Decorating started over 15 years ago in Gateshead with a simple mission: deliver quality finishes at fair prices. What began as a two-man operation has grown to a trusted local team, known across Newcastle and Gateshead for turning tired rooms into spaces our customers love living in.
about_para_2: We believe the detail is everything. That's why we spend time on preparation, use quality paints and materials, and never cut corners for speed. Our repeat customers come back because they know we'll show up on time, leave the site clean, and stand behind our work.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Ace

reviews.text: Had the whole lounge redecorated — new paint, wallpaper feature wall, doors and skirting all done. Ace turned up when they said, worked efficiently, and the finish is brilliant. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Needed the exterior painted after years of weather damage. They sorted the prep work, the gutters, and the whole front in just over a week. Very professional and tidy. Will use again.
reviews.author: Helen R.

reviews.text: Free quote was spot-on, no surprises. They got stuck in quickly and the quality of the wallpapering is perfect. Would definitely have them back for the bedrooms.
reviews.author: David M.
